TC-13/S28.detail: Re-run 17:03. (a) both modes, thrown and 'unreadable': error shown, button back to 'Photograph', nothing saved, Paste works, Photograph retry works — but the error has no role=alert / live region (fails U15). The thrown read shows the raw server text (the mock mimics dev's Vertex 404; the app prints it verbatim). (b) Hospital passes: 'Prior note saved, but extraction failed. Expand it and tap Extract Fields to retry.' (role=alert), note kept; Extract Fields then fills imaging/background with no further tap. The primary-model fallback is proven in-process only (extractPriorNote Haiku ×2 → Mistral, diagnostics row Mistral fellBackFrom Haiku with providerMs); end to end it needs aiProvider:_set (out of bounds), so (b) is partly covered. Nursing Home stores the note with no extraction (Q4, recorded). (c) axe color-contrast (serious) on the panel heading in every state and view; date and note fields labelled only by placeholders; under the matrix's ≥ 24 px size rule the 'Note · <date>' toggle (276×16) and the delete button (21×21) are too small on Pixel 7 / iPhone 15 — but axe's target-size rule (WCAG 2.5.8, which allows the spacing exception) finds 0 violations in every state and view, so this is not a WCAG 2.5.8 failure. No sideways scroll, nothing truncated or covered.
TC-13/S28.productIssue: (1) A failed photo read is not announced to assistive technology (no role=alert / live region), and when the read service errors the physician reads '[CONVEX A(ai/vision:scanPriorNote)] [Request ID: …] Server Error Uncaught Error: Vertex AI request failed: 404 …' (TC-13 U15). (2) Previous Notes panel: low-contrast heading (axe color-contrast, WCAG 1.4.3) and placeholder-only labels on the date and note fields (WCAG 1.3.1/3.3.2) — TC-13 S28 oracle. Tap targets under the matrix's 24 px rule (16 px-high toggle, 21 px delete) on phones; axe target-size passes (spacing exception), so this is the matrix's rule, not WCAG 2.5.8. Observation: after a pasted note is saved, a photo read appends to the old text in the paste box (the note appears twice).
